title: Kitchen Placement in South-East (Agni Corner)
content: The South-East quadrant is governed by Agni (the Fire element). Placing the kitchen in the South-East ensures optimal energy, health, and vitality for the occupants. Cooking should ideally be done facing East. If the kitchen is correctly placed here, fire energy stays balanced with domestic harmony.

title: Non-Structural Remedy for Kitchen in North-East (Ishanya Dosha)
content: Kitchen in North-East (Water & Divine Zone) creates a severe Fire-Water elemental conflict (Ishanya Agni Dosha). For rented apartments or structures where relocation is impossible, apply non-structural counter-measures: 1) Place a natural green marble slab or green mat under the gas stove to create an Earth/Wood element bridge between Fire and Water. 2) Paint walls in light pastel yellow or off-white. 3) Keep a sea salt bowl in the kitchen corner, replacing it weekly. 4) Avoid red or dark orange colors in North-East kitchen decor.

title: Master Bedroom Placement in South-West (Nairutya Corner)
content: The South-West quadrant represents the Earth element (Nairutya), symbolizing stability, grounding, leadership, and longevity. The head of the household should occupy the South-West bedroom. Sleeping with the head pointing South or West enhances restful sleep and decision-making.

title: Non-Structural Remedy for Master Bedroom in North-East or South-East
content: Master Bedroom in North-East subjects occupants to high spiritual energy causing restlessness. Non-structural remedy: 1) Position the bed so the headboard rests against the South or East wall. 2) Use heavy earth-toned curtains (brown, beige, warm yellow) to add weight to the room. 3) Place lead pyramids or heavy wooden furniture in the South-West corner of the bedroom to simulate heavy Earth energy.

title: Pooja Room Placement in North-East (Ishanya Zone)
sourceReference: Manasara Treatise Part II (Sacred Space Grid)
content: The North-East (Ishanya) is the supreme spiritual corner governed by cosmic energy and the Water element. It is the ideal location for a Pooja room, meditation space, or prayer alter. Keep this area lightweight, spotlessly clean, and uncluttered to maintain maximum positive pranic flow.

title: Non-Structural Remedy for Pooja Room in South or South-West
content: Pooja room placed in South-West (Earth/Heavy zone) dampens spiritual vibrations. Non-structural remedy: 1) Use a wooden mandir cabinet raised above ground level. 2) Keep a small brass bowl filled with fresh water and yellow flowers in the North-East corner of the mandir. 3) Light a ghee lamp daily facing East during prayers. 4) Use light yellow or white lighting inside the shrine.

title: Main Entrance Guidelines (North, East, North-East)
content: Main entrance facing North (Kuber zone), East (Indra zone), or North-East attracts prosperity, vital energy, and opportunities. The entrance door should open inwards in a clockwise direction, be well-lit, and remain free from dark shadows or clutter.

title: Non-Structural Remedy for South Facing Entrance
content: South facing entrance (Yama quadrant) can bring instability if uncorrected. Non-structural remedy: 1) Fix a Vastu copper helix or Hanuman Chalisa Yantra above the outer door frame. 2) Place a threshold made of brass or wood at the entrance door to seal energy leaks. 3) Place two bright warm lights outside the doorway. 4) Ensure no dark colors or black door mats are used at the threshold; prefer red or warm neutral mats.

title: Bathroom Placement Guidelines (North-West / Vayu Zone)
content: North-West (Air/Vayu element) is the ideal quadrant for bathrooms and toilets, facilitating the rapid elimination of waste and negative energy. Ensure proper ventilation and keep the toilet lid closed when not in use.

title: Non-Structural Remedy for Bathroom in North-East or South-East
content: Bathroom in North-East is a major Vastu defect affecting health and clarity. Non-structural non-demolition remedy: 1) Place a glass bowl filled with raw sea salt inside the bathroom, replaced every 7 days. 2) Hang a zinc Vastu pyramid strip on the outer side of the bathroom door frame. 3) Keep the bathroom door strictly closed at all times. 4) Place a indoor spider plant or money plant inside the bathroom to absorb stagnant moisture energy.

title: Living Room Placement (North, East, North-East)
content: Living rooms are best placed in the North, East, or North-East to foster warm social interactions and positive guest impressions. Heavy furniture should be arranged along the South and West walls, keeping the North and East sides open and light.

title: General Apartment Remedial Guidelines for Rented Properties
content: For rented apartments where structural wall alterations are prohibited: 1) Use elemental color therapy (light blues/whites in North, warm greens in East, pastels in South-East, off-white/beige in South-West). 2) Leverage movable brass/wooden pyramids and indoor plants to balance directional gaps. 3) Maintain clean center space (Brahmasthan) free of heavy tables or obstructions.
